fichas.title: Construction Work Scheduling Methods
fichas.summary: Presents a building schedule as a bar chart and a network diagram using the forward arrow method / Critical Path Method (CPM). Explains bar charts, line diagrams, and network diagrams for scheduling construction activities, showing their uses and limitations.
uses: Plan and monitor construction activity durations
Show work activities against construction time
Represent time-distance relationships and work progress
Analyze, plan, and control complex construction sequences

dimensions.label: Activity week axis
dimensions.context: Printed horizontal scale of the building schedule bar chart.

fichas.title: Supervision and Support of Construction
fichas.summary: Outlines basic and special services for construction supervision and support. Basic services include compliance checks, coordination, schedule and cost control, acceptance, defect monitoring, documentation, and handover. Special services include payment and progress schedules, as-built drawings, building security and administration, and maintenance-related tasks.
uses: Supervise construction for compliance with permits, drawings, specifications, and regulations
Monitor structural work and coordinate project participants
Track construction time, costs, invoices, and defects
Support acceptance, handover, documentation, and post-handover maintenance
